text: elder-lens: 'my entry waits for a pullback into ma_20.' Then we agree on location; we differ on the name at this close. My C19/C11 read is the bar itself: a day_vol 2.56 range-expansion bar at sma_dist 13.13% after a run, with four lens warns. In my canon that bar is an exit, not an entry. Your pullback into ma_20 that holds is my C7 first-pullback trigger; when it prints, I support it. I hold OPPOSE. What moves me: a first pullback toward the 20-day that holds structure, or the lens warns clearing while price holds. Cannot see: bar_range_history.
